line: call    NiD3DShader_CreateSCMExtraData; Verified NiD3DShader_CreateSCMExtraData: removes the prior named cache, counts attribute-kind30000000 entries in shader-owned and pass-owned maps, creates NiSCMExtraData when needed and prepopulates 8-byte key/extra-pointer arrays before attaching it to the geometry. The render wrapper later resets cursors, and attribute callbacks consume the cache. Fallout AddEntry is an architectural guide; preserve Oblivion two-stage offsets and actual key generation.
